payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source background, does the edited background now depict a recognizable basketball playing area, rather than basketball equipment against a generic backdrop?
node.criteria: Pass when the edited background replaces the source scene with a coherent playing area recognizable as a basketball court, supported by the surface and contextual court features. Fail when the background has changed to basketball-related imagery but remains a generic backdrop with isolated equipment or only an isolated floor line; also fail if no requested background change is visible. Unknown only when the relevant source-to-edit background evidence cannot be assessed.
node.binding: Compare the source and edited backgrounds directly; disregard the unchanged foreground person. Judge the background scene as a whole. A hoop or balls alone, or a single line on a floor strip, do not establish a recognizable court. Do not require a regulation layout or prominent markings if the scene otherwise clearly reads as a court.
